description.value: A shortened 38-item Inventory for Depression and Anxiety Symptoms-II was administered as a self-report measure producing Dysphoria, Panic, Suicidality, Social Anxiety, Traumatic Avoidance, and Traumatic Intrusions scores. description.value: Participants completed shape-matching and emotional face-matching trials in 30-second blocks.

spans.text: During the task, participants completed shape-matching and emotional face-matching trials in 30-second blocks.

description.value: Emotion face-matching condition: participants viewed three actor faces, with anger or fear expressions, and selected the lower face whose emotional expression matched the target face. Six trials were presented in each 30-second block.
Shape-matching control condition: participants viewed a target geometric shape and two candidate shapes and selected the matching candidate. Six trials were presented in each 30-second block.

spans.text: Participants used their right hand to respond, pressing one of two buttons on a Current Designs button box to indicate whether the left or right stimulus matched the top stimulus.

instructions.value: During emotional face-matching blocks, participants selected which of two faces at the bottom of the screen showed the same emotion as the target face at the top. During shape-matching blocks, they selected which bottom shape matched the target shape.

stimuli.value: Black-and-white photographs of White male and female actors displaying anger or fear, solid black geometric shapes on white rectangles, and white rectangles during rest blocks.

spans.text: Face stimuli included black and white photos of White male and female actors posing facial expressions of anger or fear ( Ekman & Friesen, 1977 ).
